title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.76
summary: Globale Aufnahmepläne für alle Kameras mit atomarem Speichern und 24-Stunden-Zeitfenster.
changes: Apply the selected camera recording plans to every configured camera in one atomic transaction
Offer optional bulk retention policies while preserving them by default
Add 24-hour all-day schedule selection to weekday/event recording windows
Preserve all camera credentials, archive files and camera-specific ONVIF profiles
Regression tests for global rollback, 24-hour calendar and UI safeguards
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.76
description: Global recording plan template with opt-in retention bulk-apply and calendar-accurate 24h setting.
releaseNotes: 2.20.76 introduces an explicitly confirmed global apply action for recording plans on all cameras, plus optionally retention rules. Plans are saved transactionally, each camera receives independent plan IDs and source-specific profiles are not copied. The scheduled/event time editor offers a full-day (00:00 to 00:00) option while respecting selected weekdays and holiday exceptions. Existing archives are unaffected.
